_about: Hand labels for the thesis check (analysis/thesis_check.py). DRAFT: labelled by Claude, not yet reviewed - correct any row and set reviewed to true. Each row pairs a holding's thesis (its watchlist catalyst at labelling time) with a headline. stance: contradicts = the headline undermines a specific claim in the thesis; supports = concrete progress on one; unrelated = anything else, including price moves, ratings and results that touch no claim. Rows without `synthetic` are real headlines attributed to the holding in the 2026-09-26 corpus. Rows marked synthetic are COUNTERFACTUAL headlines written for this file to test that clear contradictions are caught - they are not news and never enter the pipeline. Score with: python scripts/eval_events.py --reader thesis
